headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 20, 2026**
article:
The Minnesota Twins suffered a blowout loss to the Cleveland Guardians, while the New York Yankees secured a win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Toronto Blue Jays, and the Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles in a thrilling finish.

Top MLB news saw the Twins fall to the Guardians in a 13-4 loss, with Petey Halpin leading the Guardians' charge. The Yankees took down the Pirates 8-5, led by Jazz Chisholm Jr.'s 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. The Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes contributing to the win with a home run. The Red Sox rallied past the Orioles in a thrilling finish, securing a crucial win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Zack Kelly, a right-handed pitcher for the Boston Red Sox, has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Max Meyer, a right-handed pitcher for the Miami Marlins, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 19, 2026, with a neck strain. Phil Maton, a right-handed pitcher for the Chicago Cubs, has been placed on the 15-day injured list with right knee tendinitis.

The MLB trade market has been active, with several key moves made in recent days. The Los Angeles Dodgers acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies, sending right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek to the Rockies. The Chicago Cubs acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles acquired right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall to Guardians in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins suffered a 13-4 loss to the Cleveland Guardians, with the Guardians' offense dominating the game. Petey Halpin led the Guardians' charge with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Pirates 8-5**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-8 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Jazz Chisholm Jr. leading the Pirates' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs. Wilber Dotel pitched 3 strong innings for the Pirates, striking out 5 batters without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Blue Jays 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Nick Fortes leading the charge at the plate. Fortes hit a home run on a fly ball to left center field, contributing to his 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Rally Past Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox edged the Baltimore Orioles 6-5, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Red Sox RHP Zack Kelly Lands on 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Boston Red Sox right-handed pitcher Zack Kelly has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Acquire Halvorsen in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers have acquired right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen in a trade with the Colorado Rockies. Halvorsen joins the Dodgers in exchange for right-handed pitcher Nick Frasso and outfielder Landyn Vidourek.
